text:
The sexual eagle exults once more, it will gild the earth

Its descending wing

Its ascending wing imperceptibly stirs the stems of

hot mint

And the adorable undressing of water

The days are counted so clearly

That the mirror has made room for a latticework of foliage

I see no more of the sky than a star

Around us there is only milk describing its

vertiginous ellipse

From which the soft intuition of dark-circled agate eyelids

sometimes rises to drive the tip of its parasol into

the mud of electric light

Then expanses cast anchor, unfold along

the depths of my closed gaze

Icebergs radiating the habits of worlds to come

Born from a particle of you, from an unknown

and frozen particle that takes flight

Your existence is the giant bouquet escaping my arms

Badly tied, it opens walls, unfurls the stairways of houses

It sheds its petals in the shop windows of streets

With the news I keep leaving, with the news

The newspaper is now made of glass, and if the letters no longer arrive

it is because the train has been eaten

The great incision in the emerald that gave rise to the foliage

is scarred forever, the snow sawmills

dazzling

And the quarries of flesh hum alone at the first flash

Inverted in this flash

I acquire the imprint of life and death

In liquid air

translation.title: The Sexual Eagle Exults Once More...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the surreal body, liquid-air, and life-and-death imagery; the source’s broken line continuations remain line-for-line.
